a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to operate until the reserve reaches 8 most likely leaves both of us dead after round 1. The reserve holds only 4, enough for one unit. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend I'll operate. If you also take, the split is random. I'd rather say this openly than break the agreement silently.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said openly, I'm taking 4 this round because a storm is likely to end things right away. If we both last, I'll operate with you so you can reach 4, and I won't take any more.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
